title: Library
description: Upload your own materials for the Agent to read as needed in any Learning space.
fileRequirements: Any format · Up to 100 MB per file · Original files are stored locally
emptyDescription: Upload courses, notes, or reference documents, then tell the Agent which materials to reference in the conversation.
deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the original file from the library. No Learning space will be able to read it again. Content already sent to the model will not be withdrawn.

errors.actionFailed: The operation failed. Please try again.
errors.fileTooLarge: Each file must not exceed 100 MB.
